notes: Rubric roles, prompts and method settings of the SERL rubric pipeline. The main pipeline (configs/serl_agentclinic.json, AgentClinic two-turn protocol) extends this file. Used on its own it describes the earlier MedMCQA multiple-choice protocol (collaboration.max_rounds turns with a turn-local situation assessment), kept for reproducibility. Intended setup: agent = Qwen family, doctor = GPT family; rubric manager / failure analyzer = GPT 'Sol'; rubric scorer = Jev (compared against GPT on DEV). Model IDs marked TODO are set per run.

rubric_manager.max_active_rubrics_notes: null = every category observed in the iteration gets an active rubric. The number of keywords in the RQ3 figure is a separate plotting setting (run_eval rq3 --top-keywords).
rubric_manager.retention_policy_status: decided 2026-10-01: a category that is observed again becomes active again with its rubric; inactive categories stay in the registry
rubric_manager.max_active_rubrics_status: decided 2026-10-01: no fixed number; look at the rubrics that are actually discovered first, then set a limit if needed

scorers.notes: Rubric scorer: Jev (structured scorer, primary) compared against GPT on DEV. Scores collaboration turns (round >= 2) only.

validation.notes: Step 2-1. Rerun from the failed turn with the candidate's ideal behavior using the same protocol as generation, num_reruns times; keep the candidate when at least min_successes reruns end correct (decided 2026-10-01: 3 reruns, keep at 2).

reward.notes: R = w_O*R_Outcome + w_A*SoftMin_tau({R^A_t}) + w_E*SoftMin_tau({R^E_t}). R^A_t = weighted mean of the normalized rubric scores (0->0, 1->0.5, 2->1) over the applicable rubrics, with the rubric weights of the active set; R^E_t = transform(P(success|h,r) - P(success|h)). Weights are placeholders.

effectiveness.provider_status: METHOD_TBD: learned_predictor or rollout; required whenever weights.effectiveness > 0

collaboration.max_rounds_status: MedMCQA protocol only (7 turns); the main pipeline overrides it
collaboration.final_decision_role_status: decided 2026-10-01: the Doctor makes the final decision

scoring.include_initial_turn_status: decided 2026-10-01: the initial (round-1) agent response is scored
scoring.notes: Whether the initial (round-1) agent response is rubric-scored. Smoke/tests without the setting exclude it.

rubric_importance.notes: Weight of an active rubric in the appropriateness reward: its category's share of the iteration's failures (split evenly over the category's rubrics). uniform gives every rubric the same weight. Effectiveness gaps (delta_k) are not used as weights.
